# ggsegJHU

JHU White Matter Atlases for the ggsegverse Ecosystem.

## Installation

``` r
# From r-universe
install.packages("ggsegJHU", repos = "https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev")

# From GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ggsegverse/ggsegJHU")
```

## Atlases

### jhu_tracts

JHU white matter tract atlas (20 tracts).

``` r
library(ggsegJHU)
plot(jhu_tracts())
```

![](reference/figures/README-jhu_tracts-1.png)

### jhu_labels

ICBM-DTI-81 white matter labels (48 regions).

``` r
plot(jhu_labels())
```

![](reference/figures/README-jhu_labels-1.png) \## Data source

JHU-ICBM white matter atlases from FSL.

- **Reference**: Hua et al. (2008) NeuroImage 39(1):336-347; Mori et
  al. (2005)
- **Date obtained**: 2020-03-27

# Package index

## Atlases

JHU and ICBM white matter atlases

- [`icbm()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegJHU/reference/icbm.md) :
  ICBM-DTI-81 White Matter Atlas
- [`jhu_labels()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegJHU/reference/jhu_labels.md)
  : JHU ICBM-DTI-81 White Matter Labels
- [`jhu_tracts()`](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegJHU/reference/jhu_tracts.md)
  : JHU White Matter Tract Atlas
